content: The recommended dosage of ZYRTEC-D 12 HOUR™ Extended Release Tablets for adults and children aged 12 years and older is one tablet taken twice daily. For patients with impaired renal function (creatinine clearance between 11-31 mL/min), patients undergoing hemodialysis (creatinine clearance less than 7 mL/min), and patients with hepatic impairment, the recommended dosage is reduced to one tablet taken once daily. ZYRTEC-D 12 HOUR™ Extended Release Tablets can be administered with or without food. The tablets should be swallowed whole and must not be broken or chewed. This information is adapted from the FDA package insert.
